tasks.label: cargo build unit tests
tasks.detail: Builds the test binary and stages it as target/debug/unittests.exe (with its .pdb) so launch.json has a stable path.
args: $a = cargo test --no-run --bin=prothesis-logger-wrapper --message-format=json | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\{' } | ConvertFrom-Json | Where-Object { $_.reason -eq 'compiler-artifact' -and $_.profile.test -eq $true -and $_.executable } | Select-Object -Last 1; if (-not $a) { throw 'cargo produced no test executable' }; Copy-Item $a.executable 'target/debug/unittests.exe' -Force; $pdb = [IO.Path]::ChangeExtension($a.executable, '.pdb'); if (Test-Path $pdb) { Copy-Item $pdb 'target/debug/' -Force }
